concepts.label: angiosarcoma
concepts.description: A vascular cancer that derives_from the cells that line the walls of blood vessels or lymphatic vessels.

concepts.label: juvenile myelomonocytic leukemia
concepts.description: A myelodysplastic/myeloproliferative neoplasm that is characterized by the uncontrolled growth of monocytes.

concepts.label: adult T-cell leukemia/lymphoma
concepts.description: A T-cell acute leukemia that results_in abnormal increase of lymphocytes, derives_from T-cells, has_material_basis_in human T-cell leukemia virus type 1 (Deltaretrovirus priTlym1), which is transmitted_by sexual contact, transmitted_by contaminated needles used by intravenous-drug users, and tran...

concepts.label: gastrointestinal neuroendocrine tumor
concepts.description: A gastrointestinal system cancer that has_material_basis_in neuroendocrine cells.

concepts.label: mature T-cell and NK-cell lymphoma
concepts.description: A T-cell non-Hodgkin lymphoma that has_material_basis_in mature T lymphocytes and natural killer cells.
synonyms: mature T-cell and natural killer cell lymphoma

concepts.label: anaplastic large cell lymphoma
concepts.description: A non-Hodgkin lymphoma involving aberrant T-cells.

concepts.label: diffuse large B-cell lymphoma
concepts.description: A large B-cell lymphoma that is consisting of medium-sized to large B cells with a diffuse growth pattern.

concepts.label: mantle cell lymphoma
concepts.description: A B-cell lymphocytic neoplasm due to CD5 positive antigen-naive pregerminal center B-cell within the mantle zone that surrounds normal germinal center follicles.

concepts.label: marginal zone lymphoma
concepts.description: A B-cell lymphoma arising from the marginal zone of lymphoid tissues that is characterized by the presence of small to medium sized atypical lymphocytes.

concepts.label: peripheral T-cell lymphoma
concepts.description: A mature T-cell and NK-cell lymphoma includes a group of T-cell lymphomas that develop away from the thymus.

concepts.label: T-cell large granular lymphocyte leukemia
concepts.description: A T-cell acute lymphocytic leukemia that exhibits an unexplained, chronic (greater than 6 months) elevation in large granular lymphocytes (LGLs) in the peripheral blood.

concepts.label: pheochromocytoma
concepts.description: An endocrine organ benign neoplasm that arises within the adrenal medulla, releasing epinephrines and norepinephrines hormones that cause either episodic or persistent high blood pressure.

concepts.label: paraganglioma
concepts.description: A pheochromocytoma that arises in extraadrenal sympathetic ganglia.

concepts.label: juvenile polyposis syndrome
concepts.description: A gastrointestinal system disease that is characterized by predisposition to hamartomatous benign polyps in the gastrointestinal tract, specifically in the stomach, small intestine, colon, and rectum.

concepts.label: glioblastoma proneural subtype
concepts.description: A glioblastoma that is characterized by IDH1 and p53 mutations and Platelet Derived Growth Factor A amplification.

concepts.label: colorectal adenocarcinoma
concepts.description: A colorectal carcinoma that derives_from epithelial cells of glandular origin.

concepts.label: oral squamous cell carcinoma
concepts.description: An oral cavity cancer that has_material_basis_in squamous cells.

concepts.label: fibroma
concepts.description: A connective tissue benign neoplasm composed of fibrous or connective tissues that derives_from mesenchymal tissue.

concepts.label: follicular lymphoma
concepts.description: A B-cell lymphoma that is characterized as an indolent non-Hodgkin's lymphoma and has_material_basis_in follicle center B-cells (centrocytes and centroblasts).

concepts.label: adrenal gland pheochromocytoma
concepts.description: A malignant pheochromocytoma that is characterized by overproduction of adrenaline.

concepts.label: ameloblastoma
concepts.description: A cell type benign neoplasm that has_material_basis_in odontogenic epithelium.

concepts.label: bone squamous cell carcinoma
concepts.description: A bone carcinoma that derives_from squamous epithelial cells.

concepts.label: bone chondrosarcoma
concepts.description: A chondrosarcoma that is located_in bone.

concepts.label: brain stem medulloblastoma
concepts.description: A brain stem cancer that begins in the lower part of the brain on the floor of the skull.

concepts.label: sacrum chordoma
concepts.description: A spinal chordoma that is located_in the sacrum.

concepts.label: corpus callosum oligodendroglioma
concepts.description: A brain oligodendroglioma located_in the corpus callosum.

concepts.label: medulloblastoma
concepts.description: An infratentorial cancer that is located_in the lower part of the brain and is a type of primitive neuroectodermal tumor.

concepts.label: parietal lobe ependymoma
concepts.description: A parietal lobe neoplasm that has_material_basis_in cells lining the ventricles of the brain.

concepts.label: salivary gland carcinoma
concepts.description: A salivary gland cancer that has_material_basis_in epithelial cells.

concepts.label: inflammatory myofibroblastic tumor
concepts.description: A mesenchymal cell neoplasm that has_material_basis_in myofibroblastic cells admixed with inflammatory cells.

concepts.label: mixed extragonadal germ cell cancer
concepts.description: A mixed germ cell cancer that is located_in areas of the body other than the ovary or testicle.

concepts.label: myelodysplastic syndrome
concepts.description: A bone marrow cancer that is characterized by under production of white blood cells, red blood cells and platelets.

concepts.label: extranodal marginal zone lymphoma of mucosa-associated lymphoid tissue
concepts.description: A marginal zone B-cell lymphoma that has_material_basis_in mucosal tissue involved in antibody production.

concepts.label: appendix carcinoid tumor
concepts.description: An appendix cancer that has_material_basis_in neurodendocrine cells.

concepts.label: large intestine adenocarcinoma
concepts.description: A large intestine cancer that has_material_basis_in epithelial cells of glandular origin.

concepts.label: bronchus mucoepidermoid carcinoma
concepts.description: A mucoepidermoid carcinoma located_in the bronchus.

concepts.label: lung combined type small cell adenocarcinoma
concepts.description: A lung combined type small cell carcinoma that has_material_basis_in epithelial tissue of glandular origin.

concepts.label: vaginal carcinoma
concepts.description: A vaginal cancer that has_material_basis_in epithelial cells.

concepts.label: trachea mucoepidermoid carcinoma
concepts.description: A mucoepidermoid carcinoma located_in the trachea.

concepts.label: tonsil squamous cell carcinoma
concepts.description: A tonsil cancer that has_material_basis_in squamous cells.

concepts.label: pharynx squamous cell carcinoma
concepts.description: A pharynx cancer that has_material_basis_in squamous cells.

concepts.label: gastrointestinal carcinoma
concepts.description: A gastrointestinal system cancer that has_material_basis_in epithelial cells.

concepts.label: spindle epithelial tumor with thymus-like differentiation tumor
concepts.description: A thyroid gland carcinoma that has_material_basis_in compact bundles of long spindle epithelial cells that merge with tubulopapillary structures and/or mucinous glands.
synonyms: spindle epithelial tumour with thymus-like differentiation tumour

concepts.label: striated muscle rhabdoid tumor
concepts.description: A muscle cancer that is located_in striated muscle and has_material_basis_in rhabdoid cells which are large cells with eccentrically located nuclei and abundant, eosinophilic cytoplasm.

concepts.label: small intestine carcinoid neuroendocrine tumor
concepts.description: A neuroendocrine tumor that has_material_basis_in cells of the neuroendocrine system and that is located in the small intestine.

concepts.label: jejunal adenocarcinoma
concepts.description: A jejunal cancer that is located_in the jejunum and has_material_basis_in epithelial tissue that has glandular origin.

concepts.label: ovarian melanoma
concepts.description: An ovarian cancer that has_material_basis_in melanoctyes.

concepts.label: mucosal melanoma
concepts.description: A melanoma that has_material_basis_in melanocytes located_in mucosal membranes lining the respiratory, gastrointestinal and urogenital tract.

concepts.label: sublingual gland adenoid cystic carcinoma
concepts.description: A sublingual gland cancer that is characterized by a distinctive pattern in which abnormal nests or cords of epithelial cells surround and/or infiltrate ducts or glandular structures within the affected organ.

concepts.label: parotid gland adenoid cystic carcinoma
concepts.description: A parotid gland cancer that is characterized by a distinctive pattern in which abnormal nests or cords of epithelial cells surround and/or infiltrate ducts or glandular structures within the affected organ.

concepts.label: lung mucoepidermoid carcinoma
concepts.description: A lung carcinoma that has_material_basis_in a combination of squamous cells, mucus secreting cells and intermediate cells.

concepts.label: ovarian serous carcinoma
concepts.description: An ovarian carcinoma that has_material_basis_in the lining of the ovary and produces a serum-like fluid.

concepts.label: ovarian clear cell carcinoma
concepts.description: An ovarian carcinoma that has_material_basis_in cells with clear cytoplasm and glycogen secreting hob nail cells.

concepts.label: cervical neuroblastoma
concepts.description: An extracranial neuroblastoma that has_material_basis_in immature nerve cells.

concepts.label: extra-adrenal pheochromocytoma
concepts.description: A malignant pheochromocytoma that originate in the ganglia of the sympathetic nervous system and are named based upon the primary anatomical site of origin.

concepts.label: retroperitoneal neuroblastoma
concepts.description: A retroperitoneal cancer that has_material_basis_in immature nerve cells.

concepts.label: breast lobular carcinoma
concepts.description: A breast carcinoma that derives_from breast lobules (milk glands).

concepts.label: uterine corpus endometrial carcinoma
concepts.description: A uterine corpus cancer that is derives_from the inner lining of the uterus.

concepts.label: endocervical adenocarcinoma
concepts.description: An endocervical carcinoma that derives_from epithelial cells of glandular origin.

concepts.label: lymphoma
concepts.description: A hematologic cancer that affects lymphocytes that reside in the lymphatic system and in blood-forming organs.

concepts.label: non-Hodgkin lymphoma
concepts.description: A lymphoma that is characterized as any kind of lymphoma except Hodgkin's lymphoma.

concepts.label: estrogen receptor-positive breast cancer
concepts.description: A hormone receptor-positive breast cancer that is characterized by the presence of estrogen receptors.

concepts.label: estrogen receptor-negative breast cancer
concepts.description: A hormone receptor-negative breast cancer that is characterized by the absence of estrogen receptors.

concepts.label: HER2 positive breast cancer
concepts.description: A breast cancer that is characterized by excess HER2 (EBBR2) protein.
synonyms: human epidermal growth factor 2 positive breast cancer
human epidermal growth factor receptor 2 positive breast cancer

concepts.label: HER2 negative breast cancer
concepts.description: A breast cancer that is characterized by the absence of HER2 (EBBR2) protein.
synonyms: human epidermal growth factor 2 negative breast cancer
human epidermal growth factor receptor 2 negative breast cancer

concepts.label: triple-negative breast cancer
concepts.description: A breast cancer that is characterized by the absence of estrogen, progresterone and HER2 (EBBR2) receptors.
synonyms: hormone receptor negative/human epidermal growth factor receptor 2 negative breast cancer
human epidermal growth factor receptor 2 negative/hormone receptor negative breast cancer

concepts.label: immune system cancer
concepts.description: An organ system cancer located_in the immune system that is characterized by uncontrolled cellular proliferation in organs of the immune system.

concepts.label: osteoblastoma
concepts.description: A bone benign neoplasm of the bone that is characterized by clinical and histological similarity to osteoid osteomas.

concepts.label: central nervous system embryonal tumor
concepts.description: A central nervous system cancer of children and young adults that develops from neural crest cells located_in cerebrum, has_material_basis_in abnormally proliferating cells derives_from neuroectoderm.
synonyms: central nervous system primitive neuroectodermal neoplasm

concepts.label: cerebellar medulloblastoma
concepts.description: A cerebellum cancer that begins in the lower part of the brain on the floor of the skull.

concepts.label: brain glioma
concepts.description: A brain cancer that has_material_basis_in glial cells.

concepts.label: lymph node adenoid cystic carcinoma
concepts.description: A lymph node carcinoma that is characterized by a distinctive pattern in which abnormal nests or cords of epithelial cells surround and/or infiltrate ducts or glandular structures of the lymph nodes. These structures are typically filled with a mucous-like material or contain abnormal fibrous mem...

concepts.label: acute promyelocytic leukemia
concepts.description: An acute myeloid leukemia characterized by accumulation of promyelocytes in the bone marrow and by a translocation between chromosomes 15 and 17.

concepts.label: NUT midline carcinoma
concepts.description: A carcinoma that is characterized by a BRD4-NUT translocation involving the rearrangement of the bromodomain-containing protein 4 (BRD4) and the gene encoding nuclear protein of the testis (NUT) at 15q14, BRD4-NUT t(15;19)(q14;q13.1) and arises from midline epithelial structures, most commonly th...
synonyms: nuclear protein in testis midline carcinoma

concepts.label: Kabuki syndrome
concepts.description: A syndrome characterized by multiple congenital anomalies and mental retardation. Other characteristics include a peculiar facial gestalt, short stature, skeletal and visceral abnormalities, cardiac anomalies, and immunological defects.

concepts.label: B-cell adult acute lymphocytic leukemia
concepts.description: An adult acute lymphoblastic leukemia occurring in adults and that has_material_basis_in B lymphocytes.

concepts.label: atypical chronic myeloid leukemia, BCR-ABL1 negative
concepts.description: A myelodysplastic myeloproliferative neoplasm characterized by the principal involvement of the neutrophil series with leukocytosis and multilineage dysplasia. The neoplastic cells do not have a Philadelphia chromosome or the BCR/ABL fusion gene.
synonyms: atypical chronic myeloid leukaemia BCR-ABL1 negative
atypical chronic myeloid leukemia BCR-ABL1 negative

concepts.label: transient myeloproliferative syndrome
concepts.description: A myeloproliferative neoplasm characterized by leukocytosis in newborns with Down syndrome.

concepts.label: lymphoplasmacytic lymphoma
concepts.description: A B-cell lymphoma characterized by the accumulation of monoclonal cells in the bone marrow and peripheral lymphoid tissues, and associated with the production of serum immunoglobulin M (IgM) monoclonal protein.

concepts.label: myeloid neoplasm
concepts.description: A bone marrow cancer that is formed of any one of the bone marrow cells belonging to the granulocytic (neutrophil, eosinophil, basophil), monocytic/macrophage, erythroid, megakaryocytic and mast cell lineages.

concepts.label: childhood hepatocellular carcinoma
concepts.description: A hepatocellular carcinoma that occurs in children and is characterized by a distinct etiological predisposition, biological behavior, and lower frequency of cirrhosis as compared to adult hepatocellular carcinoma.

concepts.label: childhood acute myeloid leukemia
concepts.description: A childhood acute myeloid leukemia that is characterized by the rapid growth of abnormal white blood cells that accumulate in the bone marrow and interfere with the production of normal blood cells.

concepts.label: systemic Epstein-Barr virus positive T-cell lymphoma of childhood
concepts.description: A childhood lymphoma that is characterized by monoclonal expansion of Epstein-Barr virus-positive T cells with an activated cytotoxic phenotype in tissues or peripheral blood.
synonyms: EBV-positive T-cell lymphoproliferative disorder of childhood
systemic EBV-positive T-cell lymphoma of childhood

concepts.label: malignant childhood adrenal gland pheochromocytoma
concepts.description: An adrenal gland pheochromocytoma that is characterized by rare chromaffin cell tumors which secrete catecholamines, and has a higher prevalence of hereditary factors and metastatis in children than adults.

concepts.label: spitzoid melanoma
concepts.description: A skin melanoma that is characterized by asymmetric shape, diameter greater than 1 cm, a lesion with a deep invasive component, and a high degree of cytologic atypia.

concepts.label: melanoma in congenital melanocytic nevus
concepts.description: A skin melanoma that arises from a congenital melanocytic nevus.
synonyms: Malignant melanoma in congenital melanocytic nevus

concepts.label: SMARCB1-deficient renal medullary carcinoma
concepts.description: A renal cell carcinoma that develops in the renal medulla.

concepts.label: fibrous dysplasia
concepts.description: A bone remodeling disease that results_in the destruction of normal bone and replacing it with fibrous bone tissue.

concepts.label: childhood acute lymphocytic leukemia
concepts.description: An acute lymphocytic leukemia occurring during childhood.

concepts.label: childhood T-cell acute lymphoblastic leukemia
concepts.description: A childhood acute lymphoblastic leukemia that has_material_basis_in T-cells.

concepts.label: childhood B-cell acute lymphoblastic leukemia
concepts.description: A childhood acute lymphoblastic leukemia that has_material_basis_in B-cells.

concepts.label: T-cell childhood lymphoblastic lymphoma
concepts.description: A lymphoblastic lymphoma that has_material_basis_in T-cells and that occurs during childhood.

concepts.label: myeloid and lymphoid neoplasms with eosinophilia and abnormalities of PDGFRA, PDGFRB, and FGFR1
concepts.description: A myeloid neoplasm that is characterized by the formation of abnormal fusion genes that encode constitutively activated tyrosine kinases.
synonyms: Myeloid and Lymphoid Neoplasms with Eosinophilia and Rearrangement of PDGFRA, PDGFRB, or FGFR1, or with PCM1-JAK2

concepts.label: mixed fibrolamellar hepatocellular carcinoma
concepts.description: A fibrolamellar carcinoma that is characterized by the presence of both pure fibrolamellar hepatocellular carcinoma and and conventional hepatocellular carcinoma components.

concepts.label: chronic neutrophilic leukemia
concepts.description: A chronic leukemia characterized by neutrophilic leukocytosis with no detectable Philadelphia chromosome or BCR/ABL fusion gene.

concepts.label: chronic myelomonocytic leukemia
concepts.description: A chronic leukemia characterized by monocytosis, increased monocytes in the bone marrow, variable degrees of dysplasia, but an absence of immature granulocytes in the blood.

concepts.label: malignant epithelioid hemangioendothelioma
concepts.description: A malignant hemangioma characterized by the presence of epithelioid endothelial cells. The neoplastic cells are arranged in cords and nests, which are embedded in a myxoid to hyalinized stroma.

concepts.label: obsolete PTEN hamartoma tumor syndrome
concepts.description: A syndrome comprised of a spectrum of related disorders characterized by the formation of hamartomas, overgrowth, and predisposition to cancer that has_material_basis_in heterozygous germline mutation in the PTEN gene on chromosome 10q23.

concepts.label: relapsed/refractory diffuse large B-cell lymphoma
concepts.description: A diffuse large B-cell lymphoma characterized by less than 50 percent decrease in lesion size with induction therapy or the appearance of new lesions or the appearance of new lesions after attainment of complete remission.

concepts.label: primary mediastinal B-cell lymphoma
concepts.description: A large B-cell lymphoma that is is characterized by a diffuse proliferation of medium to large B-cells associated with sclerosis.
synonyms: Large cell lymphoma of the mediastinum
Mediastinal diffuse large-cell lymphoma with sclerosis
Primary mediastinal clear cell lymphoma of B-cell type

concepts.label: malignant pheochromocytoma
concepts.description: An adrenal medulla cancer that arises within the adrenal medulla, releasing epinephrines and norepinephrines hormones.

concepts.label: endometrial hyperplasia
concepts.description: An uterine benign neoplasm that is characterized by excessive proliferation of the cells of the endometrium.

concepts.label: desmoid tumor
concepts.description: A connective tissue benign neoplasm that occur most often in the abdomen, arms and legs.

concepts.label: chronic eosinophilic leukemia
concepts.description: A chronic leukemia characterized by a clonal proliferation of eosinophilic precursors resulting in persistently increased numbers of eosinophils in the blood, marrow and peripheral tissues.

concepts.label: ovarian sex-cord stromal tumor
concepts.description: A sex cord-gonadal stromal tumor that arises from the ovary and is composed of granulosa cells, Sertoli cells, Leydig cells, theca cells, and fibroblasts.

concepts.label: epithelioid inflammatory myofibroblastic sarcoma
concepts.description: An inflammatory myofibroblastic tumor composed of epithelioid or round cells with a characteristic perinuclear or nuclear membrane staining pattern with ALK immunohistochemistry, frequently dispersed in myxoid stroma with prominent neutrophils or lymphocytes, and often absence of plasma cells.

concepts.label: anaplastic thyroid carcinoma
concepts.description: A thyroid gland carcinoma that is composed of undifferentiated cells.

concepts.label: thyroid gland adenocarcinoma
concepts.description: A thyroid gland carcinoma that derives_from epithelial cells of glandular origin.

concepts.label: differentiated high-grade thyroid carcinoma
concepts.description: A thyroid gland adenocarcinoma characterized by extensive evidence of follicular cell differentiation.

concepts.label: dedifferentiated liposarcoma
concepts.description: A liposarcoma that is characterized as a high-grade tumor that occurs when a lower-grade tumor changes and creates new high-grade cells.

concepts.label: myxofibrosarcoma
concepts.description: A sarcoma that arises from the soft tissue and is characterized by the presence of spindle-shaped cells, cellular pleomorphism, thin-walled blood vessels, fibrous septa, and myxoid stroma.

concepts.label: benign teratoma
concepts.description: A germ cell benign neoplasm that derives_from mature tissue elements or a limited amount of immature tissue elements.

concepts.label: B-lymphoblastic leukemia/lymphoma
concepts.description: A B-cell acute lymphoblastic leukemia that is characterized by the presence of too many B-cell lymphoblasts in the blood and bone marrow.

concepts.label: B-cell acute lymphoblastic leukemia
concepts.description: An acute lymphocytic leukemia characterized by too many B-cell lymphoblasts (immature white blood cells) in the bone marrow and blood.

concepts.label: B-lymphoblastic leukemia/lymphoma with BCR-ABL1
concepts.description: A B-lymphoblastic leukemia/lymphoma that derives_from B-lymphoblasts and carries a translocation between the BCR gene on chromosome 22 and the ABL1 gene on chromosome 9. It results in the production of the p190 kd or p210 kd fusion protein.

concepts.label: B-lymphoblastic leukemia/lymphoma MLL rearranged
concepts.description: A B-lymphoblastic leukemia/lymphoma that is characterized by the presence of lymphoblasts that carry a translocation between the KMT2A gene at 11q23.3 and another gene partner resulting in the production of a KMT2A related fusion protein.
synonyms: B lymphoblastic leukemia/lymphoma with t(v;11q23); MLL rearranged

concepts.label: B-lymphoblastic leukemia/lymphoma with ETV6-RUNX1
concepts.description: A B-lymphoblastic leukemia/lymphoma that is characterized by the presence of lymphoblasts that carry a translocation between the TEL gene on chromosome 12 and the AML1 gene on chromosome 21, (p13.2;q22.1). It results in the production of the TEL-AML1 (ETV6-RUNX1) fusion protein.

concepts.label: B-lymphoblastic leukemia/lymphoma with hyperdiploidy
concepts.description: A B-lymphoblastic leukemia/lymphoma that is composed of B-lymphoblasts which contain more than 50 and usually less than 66 chromosomes.

concepts.label: B-lymphoblastic leukemia/lymphoma with hypodiploidy
concepts.description: A B-lymphoblastic leukemia/lymphoma that is composed of B-lymphoblasts which contain less than 46 chromosomes.

concepts.label: B-lymphoblastic leukemia/lymphoma with IGH::IL3 fusion
concepts.description: A B-lymphoblastic leukemia/lymphoma that is characterized by the presence of lymphoblasts that carry a translocation between the IL3 gene on chromosome 5 and the IGH locus on chromosome 14, (q31.1;q32.3).

concepts.label: B-lymphoblastic leukemia/lymphoma with TCF3-PBX1
concepts.description: A B-lymphoblastic leukemia/lymphoma that is characterized by the presence of lymphoblasts that carry a translocation between the E2A gene on chromosome 19 and the PBX1 gene on chromosome 1.
synonyms: B Acute Lymphoblastic Leukemia with t(1;19)(q23;p13.3); E2A-PBX1 (TCF3-PBX1)

concepts.label: B-lymphoblastic leukemia/lymphoma, BCR-ABL1–like
concepts.description: A B-lymphoblastic leukemia/lymphoma that has a gene expression profile similar to that of B-ALL with t(9;22)(q34.1;q11.2) BCR-ABL1, but lacks that gene fusion.

concepts.label: B-lymphoblastic leukemia/lymphoma with iAMP21
concepts.description: A B-lymphoblastic leukemia/lymphoma that is characterized by amplification of a portion of chromosome 21.

concepts.label: diffuse midline glioma, H3 K27-altered
concepts.description: A histone mutated tumor that is characterized by loss of histone H3 p.K28me3 (K27me3) methylation and located throughout the midline structures of the central nervous system. concepts.label: medulloblastoma WNT activated
concepts.description: A medulloblastoma that is characterized as a molecular subtype by activation of the WNT pathway and TP53 mutations may be present or absent.

concepts.label: medulloblastoma SHH activated
concepts.description: A medulloblastoma that is characterized as a molecular subtype by activation of the sonic hedgehog (SHH) pathway and TP53 mutations that may be present or absent.

concepts.label: medulloblastoma SHH activated and TP53 mutant
concepts.description: A medulloblastoma SHH activated that is characterized as a molecular subtype by activation of the sonic hedgehog (SHH) pathway and the presence of TP53 mutations.

concepts.label: medulloblastoma SHH activated and TP53 wild-type
concepts.description: A medulloblastoma SHH activated that is characterized as a molecular subtype by activation of the sonic hedgehog (SHH) pathway and the absence of TP53 mutations.

concepts.label: medulloblastoma non-WNT/non-SHH
concepts.description: A medulloblastoma that is characterized as a molecular subtype that is not associated with activation of the WNT pathway or sonic hedgehog (SHH) pathway and TP53 mutations are absent.

concepts.label: medulloblastoma non-WNT/non-SHH group 3
concepts.description: A medulloblastoma non-WNT/non-SHH that is characterized as a molecular subtype by absent TP53 mutations and MYC amplifications that may be present.

concepts.label: medulloblastoma non-WNT/non-SHH group 4
concepts.description: A medulloblastoma non-WNT/non-SHH that is characterized as a molecular subtype by the absence of MYC amplifications and TP53 gene mutations, while chromosome 17 abnormalities may be present.

concepts.label: plasmablastic lymphoma
concepts.description: A large B-cell lymphoma that is characterized by the presence of large neoplastic cells resembling B-immunoblasts which have the immunophenotypic profile of plasma cells.

concepts.label: childhood acute megakaryoblastic leukemia
concepts.description: An acute megakaryocytic leukemia that is characterized by fusion oncogenes involving transcriptional regulators in childhood.
synonyms: pediatric non-Down syndrome acute megakaryoblastic leukemia

concepts.label: acute basophilic leukemia
concepts.description: An acute myeloid leukemia that is characterized by primary differentiation to basophils.

concepts.label: core binding factor acute myeloid leukemia
concepts.description: An acute myeloid leukemia that is characterized by the presence of t(8;21)(q22;q22) or inv(16)(p13q22)/t(16;16)(p13;q22). These cytogenetic abnormalities result in disruption of the transcription factor CBF, which is a regulator of normal hematopoiesis.

concepts.label: nasal type extranodal NK/T-cell lymphoma
concepts.description: A mature T-cell and NK-cell lymphoma that is characterized by an often angiocentric and angiodestructive cellular infiltrate composed of EBV positive NK/T cells.

concepts.label: myeloid leukemia associated with Down Syndrome
concepts.description: An acute megakaryocytic leukemia occurring in children with Down syndrome and that has_material_basis_in mutation in the GATA1 gene.

concepts.label: sinonasal undifferentiated carcinoma
concepts.description: A nasal cavity carcinoma that arises from the sinonasal tract and that is characterized by the presence of small to medium size malignant cells.

concepts.label: salivary gland mucinous adenocarcinoma
concepts.description: A salivary gland carcinoma that is characterized by the presence of large pools of extracellular mucin in which clusters of malignant epithelial cells are found.

concepts.label: mammary analogue secretory carcinoma
concepts.description: A salivary gland carcinoma that has_material_basis_in a chromosomal translocation that results in an ETV6-NTRK3 fusion gene.

concepts.label: low grade glioma
concepts.description: A cell type benign neoplasm that has_material_basis_in glial cells (astrocytes, oligodendrocytes or ependymocytes).

concepts.label: childhood low-grade glioma
concepts.description: A low-grade glioma that occurs in children and encompasses tumors of astrocytic, oligodendroglial, and mixed glial-neuronal histology.

concepts.label: anaplastic pleomorphic xanthoastrocytoma
concepts.description: A malignant astrocytoma that is characterized by the presence of five or more mitoses per 10 high-power fields.

concepts.label: IDH-mutant anaplastic astrocytoma
concepts.description: An anaplastic astrocytoma carrying IDH mutations.

concepts.label: IDH-wildtype anaplastic astrocytoma
concepts.description: An anaplastic astrocytoma lacking mutations in IDH1 or IDH2 genes.

concepts.label: astrocytoma, IDH-mutant, grade 4
concepts.description: An IDH-mutant anaplastic astrocytoma that is characterized by the presence of necrosis and/or microvascular proliferation or homozygous deletion of CDKN2A and/or CDKN2B genes. The term glioblastoma no longer applies to central nervous system WHO grade 4 IDH-mutant astrocytomas.

concepts.label: IDH-wildtype glioblastoma
concepts.description: A glioblastoma that is characterized by high cellularity, high mitotic activity, necrosis or microvascular proliferation and that lacks mutations in IDH genes.

concepts.label: histone mutated tumor
concepts.description: A high grade glioma that has_material_basis_in mutations in the genes encoding histones.

concepts.label: diffuse glioma, H3 G34 mutant
concepts.description: A histone mutated tumor that has_material_basis_in mutations in codon 34 of the H3 histone family 3A protein.

concepts.label: IDH-mutant and 1p/19q-codeleted oligodendroglioma
concepts.description: An anaplastic oligodendroglioma that has_material_basis_in IDH gene family mutation and combined whole-arm losses of 1p and 19q (1p/19q codeletion).

concepts.label: spinal ependymoma, MYCN-amplified
concepts.description: A spinal cord ependymoma that is characterized by MYCN amplification.

concepts.label: posterior fossa ependymoma
concepts.description: A high grade ependymoma that is located within the posterior fossa.

concepts.label: supratentorial ependymoma
concepts.description: A high grade ependymoma that is located within the supratentorial brain.

concepts.label: YAP1-MAMLD1 fusion-positive supratentorial ependymoma
concepts.description: A supratentorial ependymoma that has_material_basis_in YAP1-MAMLD1 fusion.

concepts.label: RELA fusion-positive ependymoma
concepts.description: A supratentorial ependymoma that has_material_basis_in presence of a RELA fusion gene.

concepts.label: pericytoma with t(7;12)
concepts.description: A perivascular tumor that is characterized by a perivascular pattern of spindle-to-ovoid cell proliferation and that has_material_basis_in t(7;12)(p22;q13) translocation with resultant ACTB-GLI1 fusion.

concepts.label: solitary fibrous tumor/hemangiopericytoma
concepts.description: A connective tissue cancer that is characterized as the combination of solitary fibrous tumors and hemangiopericytomas.

concepts.label: embryonal tumor with multilayered rosettes, C19MC-altered
concepts.description: An embryonal tumor with multilayered rosettes that is characterized by the presence of multilayered rosettes formation and the presence of amplification of the C19MC region on chromosome 19 (19q13.42).

concepts.label: astroblastoma, MN1-altered
concepts.description: An astroblastoma that is characterized by astroblastoma-like morphology with MN1 rearrangements involving the meningioma 1 (MN1) gene on chromosome 22q.
synonyms: CNS high-grade neuroepithelial tumors with MN1 alteration

concepts.label: CNS neuroblastoma with FOXR2 activation
concepts.description: A central nervous system neuroblastoma that is characterized by FOXR2 activation and that is composed of small, round cells with hyperchromatic nuclei surrounded by a clear halo.
synonyms: central nervous system neuroblastoma with FOXR2 activation

concepts.label: histiocytic sarcoma
concepts.description: A histiocytic and dendritic cell cancer that is characterized by the presence of neoplastic cells with morphologic and immunophenotypic characteristics similar to those seen in mature histiocytes.

concepts.label: childhood supratentorial embryonal tumor with multilayered rosettes, C19MC-altered
concepts.description: A childhood embryonal tumor with multilayered rosettes, C19MC-altered that arises from the supratentorial brain and occurs in children.

concepts.label: diffuse large B-cell lymphoma activated B-cell type
concepts.description: A diffuse large B-cell lymphoma that is characterized by the expression of CD44, PKCbeta1, Cyclin D2, BCL-2, and IRF4/MUM1 genes.

concepts.label: diffuse large B-cell lymphoma germinal center B-cell type
concepts.description: A diffuse large B-cell lymphoma that is characterized by the expression of CD10, BCL-6, A-myb, and LMO2 genes, BCL-2 translocation, and c-REL amplification.

concepts.label: DICER1 syndrome
concepts.description: A syndrome that is characterized by an increased risk of developing pleuropulmonary blastoma, multinodular goiter, ovarian Sertoli-Leydig cell tumors, and/or other types of tumors, and that has_material_basis_in heterozygous mutation in the DICER1 gene on chromosome 14q32. synonyms: Pleuro-pulmonary blastoma familial tumor susceptibility syndrome
Pleuropulmonary blastoma familial tumor susceptibility syndrome

concepts.label: BN2 diffuse large B-cell lymphoma
concepts.description: A diffuse large B-cell lymphoma that is categorized as BN2 with high probability by the LymphGen algorithm. concepts.label: EZB diffuse large B-cell lymphoma
concepts.description: A diffuse large B-cell lymphoma that is categorized as EZB with high probability by the LymphGen algorithm. concepts.label: MCD diffuse large B-cell lymphoma
concepts.description: A diffuse large B-cell lymphoma that is categorized as MCD with high probability by the LymphGen algorithm. concepts.label: N1 diffuse large B-cell lymphoma
concepts.description: A diffuse large B-cell lymphoma that is categorized as N1 with high probability by the LymphGen algorithm. This is based on a combination of genetic features. concepts.label: ST2 diffuse large B-cell lymphoma
concepts.description: A diffuse large B-cell lymphoma that is categorized as ST2 with high probability by the LymphGen algorithm. concepts.label: A53 diffuse large B-cell lymphoma
concepts.description: A diffuse large B-cell lymphoma that is characterized by aneuploidy with TP53 inactivation.

concepts.label: EZB-MYC+ diffuse large B-cell lymphoma
concepts.description: An EZB diffuse large B-cell lymphoma that expresses the double hit gene expression signature (DHITsig+) according to gene expression profiling. In addition to the features characteristic of EZB, these cases commonly, but do not always, harbour MYC translocations and DDX3X mutations.

concepts.label: EZB-MYC- diffuse large B-cell lymphoma
concepts.description: An EZB diffuse large B-cell lymphoma that does not express the double hit gene expression signature (DHITsig-) according to gene expression profiling. These cases tend to have few MYC translocations or DDX3X mutations.

concepts.label: acute myeloid leukemia with t(6;9) (p23;q34.1)
concepts.description: An acute myeloid leukemia associated with t(6;9)(p23;q34), resulting in DEK-NUP214(CAN) fusion protein expression. It is often associated with multilineage dysplasia and basophilia.
synonyms: Acute Myeloid Leukemia with t(6;9) (p23;q34.1); DEK-NUP214

concepts.label: acute promyelocytic leukemia with PML-RARA
concepts.description: An acute promyelocytic leukemia that is characterized by a severe coagulopathy and the t(15;17)(q24;q21), generating a PML-RARA fusion gene, and where abnormal promyelocytes predominate.

concepts.label: acute myelomonocytic leukemia
concepts.description: An acute myeloid leukemia that is characterized by the proliferation of both neutrophil and monocyte precursors.

concepts.label: acute myeloid leukemia with inv(3) (q21.3;q26.2) or t(3;3) (q21.3;q26.2)
concepts.description: An acute myeloid leukemia associated with inv(3)(q21q26.2) or t(3;3)(q21;q26.2), resulting in the expression of RPN1-EVI1 fusion protein and the reposition of a distal GATA2 enhancer to activate MECOM expression.
synonyms: Acute Myeloid Leukemia with inv(3) (q21.3;q26.2) or t(3;3) (q21.3;q26.2); GATA2, MECOM
Acute myeloid leukemia with inv(3)(q21;q26.2) or t(3;3)(q21;q26.2); RPN1-EVI1

concepts.label: acute myeloid leukemia with inv(16)(p13.1q22) or t(16;16)(p13.1;q22)
concepts.description: An acute myeloid leukemia that is characterized by the presence of abnormal bone marrow eosinophils and the characteristic cytogenetic abnormality inv(16)(p13.1q22) or t(16;16)(p13.1;q22), which results in the expression of the fusion protein CBFB-MYH11.
synonyms: Acute Myeloid Leukemia with inv(16)(p13.1q22) or t(16;16)(p13.1;q22); CBFB-MYH11
acute myeloid leukemia with abnormal marrow eosinophils

concepts.label: acute myeloid leukemia with minimal differentiation
concepts.description: An acute myeloid leukemia in which the blasts do not show evidence of myeloid differentiation by morphology and conventional cytochemistry.

concepts.label: acute myeloid leukemia without maturation
concepts.description: An acute myeloid leukemia that is characterized by blasts without evidence of significant maturation in the neutrophilic lineage.

concepts.label: acute myeloid leukemia with maturation
concepts.description: An acute myeloid leukemia characterized by blasts with evidence of significant maturation in the neutrophilic lineage.

concepts.label: chronic myelogenous leukemia, BCR-ABL1 positive
concepts.description: A chronic myeloid leukemia that is characterized by an abnormally high number of neutrophils and the expression of the BCR-ABL1 fusion gene.

concepts.label: acute myeloid leukemia with mutated NPM1
concepts.description: An acute myeloid leukemia with mutation of the nucleophosmin gene. It is usually associated with normal karyotype and frequently has myelomonocytic or monocytic features.

concepts.label: acute myeloid leukemia with biallelic mutation of CEBPA
concepts.description: An acute myeloid leukemia with double mutations of the CEBPA gene.

concepts.label: acute myeloid leukemia with mutated RUNX1
concepts.description: An acute myeloid leukemia that is characterized by de novo RUNX1 gene mutation, not associated with myelodysplastic syndrome-related cytogenetic abnormalities.

concepts.label: acute myeloid leukemia with myelodysplasia-related changes
concepts.description: An acute myeloid leukemia with at least 20% blasts in the bone marrow or blood and one of the following: a previous history of myelodysplastic syndrome; multilineage dysplasia; or myelodysplastic syndrome-related cytogenetic abnormalities.

concepts.label: acute myeloid leukemia with t(8;21); (q22; q22.1)
concepts.description: An acute myeloid leukemia associated with t(8;21)(q22;q22) resulting in RUNX1-RUNX1T1 fusion protein expression. The bone marrow and the peripheral blood show large myeloblasts with abundant basophilic cytoplasm, often containing azurophilic granules.
synonyms: Acute Myeloid Leukemia with t(8;21); (q22; q22.1); RUNX1-RUNX1T1

concepts.label: acute myeloid leukemia with MLL rearrangement
concepts.description: An acute myeloid leukemia characterized by rearrangement of the MLL (mixed-lineage leukemia) gene.
synonyms: Acute Myeloid Leukemia with KMT2A/MLL Rearrangement

concepts.label: acute myeloid leukemia with mutated CEBPA
concepts.description: An acute myeloid leukemia with non-germline mutations of the CEBPA gene.

concepts.label: acute myeloid leukemia with t(1;22)(p13;q13)
concepts.description: An acute myeloid leukemia typically showing megakaryocytic maturation and associated with t(1;22)(p13;q13), resulting in the expression of RBM15-MKL1 fusion protein.
synonyms: Acute Myeloid Leukemia (Megakaryoblastic) with t(1;22)(p13.3;q13.1); RBM15-MKL1

concepts.label: pituitary blastoma
concepts.description: A pituitary cancer that is characterized by features of Cushing disease, with elevated blood ACTH levels and hypercortisolism arising within the fetal anterior pituitary and associated with DICER1 mutations.

concepts.label: cauda equina neuroendocrine tumor
concepts.description: A cauda equina neoplasm that is a slow-growing, well-differentiated neuroendocrine tumor arising from the cauda equina.

concepts.label: teratoma with somatic-type malignancy
concepts.description: A teratoma that is characterized by morphologic transformation to malignancy and an aggressive clinical course.

concepts.label: dedifferentiated chondrosarcoma
concepts.description: A chondrosarcoma that is an aggressive morphologic variant of chondrosarcoma. It is composed of a low grade chondrosarcoma and a high grade non-cartilagenous sarcomatous component.

concepts.label: pineocytoma
concepts.description: An endocrine organ benign neoplasm arising from the pineal gland that is composed of small, uniform, mature cells resembling pineocytes with occasional large pineocytomatous rosettes. concepts.label: EWSR1-negative small round cell tumor
concepts.description: A small cell sarcoma that is characterized by the absence of EWSR1 rearrangement and the presence of small round malignant cells with a small amount of cytoplasm.
synonyms: EWSR1-Negative Small Blue Round Cell Tumor

concepts.description: An EWSERI-negative small round cell tumor that is characterized by a recurrent translocation involving the CIC gene on chromosome 19 and either DUX4 gene on chromosome 4 or DUX4L gene on chromosome 10. concepts.label: papillary tumor of the pineal region
concepts.description: A pineal gland cancer that is characterized by the presence of neuroepithelial cells and a papillary architecture.
synonyms: Papillary tumour of the pineal region

concepts.label: supratentorial ependymoma, ZFTA fusion–positive
concepts.description: A suptratentorial ependymoma that is characterized by the presence of a fusion gene involving ZFTA gene.

concepts.label: supratentorial ependymoma, YAP1 fusion–positive
concepts.description: A supratentorial ependymoma that is characterized by the presence of a fusion gene involving YAP1 gene.

concepts.label: posterior fossa group A ependymoma
concepts.description: A posterior fossa ependymoma that arises in the posterior fossa with characteristic DNA methylation patterns, including CpG island hypermethylation, global DNA hypomethylation, reduction of nuclear H3 p.K28me3 (K27me3) expression, and EZHIP overexpression.

concepts.label: posterior fossa group B ependymoma
concepts.description: A posterior fossa ependymoma that arises in the posterior fossa with characteristic DNA methylation patterns including retention of nuclear H3 p.K28me3 (K27me3) expression, absence of CpG island hypermethylation, absence of global DNA hypomethylation, and absence of EZHIP overexpression.

concepts.label: astrocytoma, IDH-mutant, grade 2
concepts.description: An IDH-mutant anaplastic astrocytoma that is characterized by the presence of well-differentiated fibrillary glial cells diffusely infiltrating the central nervous system.

concepts.label: astrocytoma, IDH-mutant, grade 3
concepts.description: An IDH-mutant anaplastic astrocytoma that is characterized by the presence of increased mitotic activity and anaplastic features.

concepts.label: desmoplastic infantile ganglioglioma / desmoplastic infantile astrocytoma
concepts.description: A ganglioglioma occurring predominantly in the cerebral hemispheres of infants, that are driven by MAPK pathway activation and composed of a mixed astrocytic and neuronal component (DIG) or an astrocytic component only (DIA) embedded in an extensive desmoplastic stroma, often containing foci of u...

concepts.label: diffuse low-grade glioma, MAPK pathway–altered
concepts.description: A low grade glioma that is characterized by a gene alteration that results in a MAPK pathway abnormality, with morphological features of astrocytoma or oligodendroglioma.

concepts.label: angiocentric glioma
concepts.description: A low grade glioma that is characterized by an angiocentric pattern, monomorphic cellular infiltrate, and ependymal differentiation.

concepts.description: A high grade glioma that is characterized by the absence of histone H3, IDH1, and IDH2 mutations.

concepts.label: diffuse astrocytoma, MYB- or MYBL1-altered
concepts.description: A diffuse astrocytoma that is a diffusely infiltrative astroglial neoplasm composed of monomorphic cells with genetic alterations in MYB or MYBL1.

concepts.label: pituicytoma
concepts.description: A posterior pituitary gland neoplasm that is characterized by the presence of elongated, spindle-shaped neoplastic glial cells that form storiform patterns or interlacing fascicular arrangements.

concepts.label: oligodendroglioma, IDH-mutant and 1p/19q-codeleted grade 2
concepts.description: An IDH-mutant, and 1p/19q-codeleted oligodendroglioma that is characterized as a well differentiated tumor lacking anaplastic features (brisk mitotic activity, microvascular proliferation, necrosis).

concepts.label: oligodendroglioma, IDH-mutant and 1p/19q-codeleted, grade 3
concepts.description: An IDH-mutant, and 1p/19q-codeleted oligodendroglioma that is characterized as grade 3 tumors associated with a more rapid growth. concepts.label: papillary glioneuronal tumor
concepts.description: A central nervous system benign neoplasm that is characterized by the presence of astrocytes that line vascular and hyalinized pseudopapillae.

concepts.label: rosette-forming glioneuronal tumor
concepts.description: A central nervous system benign neoplasm that is characterized by the presence of neurocytes forming pseudorosettes and astrocytes which contain Rosenthal fibers.

concepts.label: myxoid glioneuronal tumor
concepts.description: A central nervous system benign neoplasm that is characterized by a dinucleotide mutation at codon 385 of the PDGFR gene. concepts.label: embryonal tumor with multilayered rosettes
concepts.description: A central nervous system embryonal tumor that is characterized by the presence of multilayered rosette formation and typically the presence of amplification of the C19MC region on chromosome 19 (19q13.42) or rarely a DICER1 mutation.

concepts.label: salivary gland mucoepidermoid carcinoma
concepts.description: A mucoepidermoid carcinoma located_in the salivary gland.

concepts.label: diffuse leptomeningeal glioneuronal tumor
concepts.description: A central nervous system benign neoplasm that is characterized by the presence of clear glial neoplastic cells reminiscent of oligodendroglioma.

concepts.label: multinodular and vacuolating neuronal tumor
concepts.description: A central nervous system benign neoplasm that is composed of cells with glial and/or neuronal differentiation forming multiple nodules with prominent vacuolation and that affecting the cerebral hemispheres.

concepts.label: high-grade astrocytoma with piloid features
concepts.description: An anaplastic astrocytoma that is characterized by high-grade piloid and/or glioblastoma-like histological features. It may occur anywhere in the central nervous system but most often arises in the posterior fossa.

concepts.label: spindle cell oncocytoma
concepts.description: A posterior pituitary benign neoplasm that is characterized by the presence of spindle cells with eosinophilic, granular cytoplasm forming fascicles.

concepts.label: lymphomatoid granulomatosis
concepts.description: A lymphoproliferative syndrome that is characterized by overproduction (proliferation) of white blood cells called lymphocytes. The abnormal cells infiltrate and accumulate (form lesions or nodules) within tissues. The lesions or nodules damage or destroy the blood vessels within these tissues.

concepts.label: T-cell non-Hodgkin lymphoma
concepts.description: A non-Hodgkin lymphoma of T-cell lineage.

concepts.label: extraventricular neurocytoma
concepts.description: A cerebral ventricle cancer that is characterized by the presence of neoplastic uniform, round cells with neuronal differentiation, that arises from the brain parenchyma. Unlike central neurocytoma, it does not involve the lateral ventricles.

concepts.label: central nervous system tumor with BCOR internal tandem duplication
concepts.description: A central nervous system embryonal tumor that is characterized by the presence of uniform oval or spindle-shaped cells with round or oval nuclei, pseudorosette formation, and heterozygous internal tandem duplication in exon 15 of the BCOR gene.
synonyms: CNS tumour with BCOR internal tandem duplication

concepts.label: primary intracranial sarcoma, DICER1-mutant
concepts.description: A brain sarcoma that is composed of malignant pleomorphic or spindle neoplastic cells typically demonstrating myogenic and/or chondroid differentiation. Cytoplasmic eosinophilic globules and myxoid stroma formation are usually present. It is associated with mutations in the DICER1 gene.

concepts.label: sarcoma with BCOR genetic alterations
concepts.description: A small cell sarcoma that is characterized by the presence of small round or elongated malignant cells with a small amount of cytoplasm and the presence of BCOR genetic alterations.

concepts.label: BCOR ITD sarcoma
concepts.description: A sarcoma with BCOR genetic alterations that is characterized by the presence of BCOR internal tandem duplication.

concepts.label: BCOR-CCNB3 sarcoma
concepts.description: A sarcoma with BCOR genetic alterations that is characterized by the presence of BCOR-CCNB3 fusion gene.

concepts.label: childhood sarcoma with BCOR genetic alterations
concepts.description: A sarcoma with BCOR genetic alterations that occurs during childhood.

concepts.label: round cell sarcoma with EWSR1-non-ETS fusion
concepts.description: A small cell sarcoma that is characterized by the presence of EWSR1 or FUS fusions involving partners unrelated to the ETS gene family.
synonyms: Ewing-Like Sarcoma or Round Cell Sarcoma
Round Cell Sarcoma with EWSR1::non-ETS Fusion

concepts.description: A round cell sarcoma with EWSR1-non-ETS fusion that is characterized by EWSR1-non-ETS fusion that occurs during childhood.

concepts.label: round cell sarcoma with EWSR1-NFATC2 gene fusion
concepts.description: A round cell sarcoma with EWSR1-non-ETS fusion that is characterized by the presence of EWSR1-NFATC2 gene fusion.

concepts.label: round cell sarcoma with EWSR1-PATZ1 gene fusion
concepts.description: A round cell sarcoma with EWSR1-non-ETS fusion that is characterized by the presence of EWSR1-PATZ1 gene fusion.

concepts.label: round cell sarcoma with FUS-NFATC2 gene fusion
concepts.description: A round cell sarcoma with EWSR1-non-ETS fusion that is characterized by the presence of FUS-NFATC2 gene fusion.

concepts.label: B-lymphoblastic leukemia with PAX5 p.P80R
concepts.description: A B-lymphoblastic leukemia/lymphoma that is associated with PAX5 P80R mutation.
synonyms: B acute lymphoblastic leukemia with PAX5 P80R mutation

concepts.label: B-lymphoblastic leukemia with DUX4 rearrangement
concepts.description: A B lymphoblastic leukemia/lymphoma that is associated with DUX4 gene rearrangement.
synonyms: B acute lymphoblastic leukemia with DUX4 rearrangement

concepts.label: renal cell carcinoma with MiT translocations
concepts.description: A renal cell carcinoma that is characterized by papillary, alveolar and nested growth patterns with clear and eosinophilic cells and that is associated with translocations/gene fusions involving members of the MiT family of transcription factors.
synonyms: MiT Family Translocation-Associated Renal Cell Carcinoma
MiT family translocation renal cell carcinoma

concepts.label: TFEB-rearranged renal cell carcinoma
concepts.description: A renal cell carcinoma with MiT translocations that is characterized by the presence of the chromosomal translocation t(6;11) which fuses the TFEB transcription factor gene, located on chromosome 6, with the MALAT1 gene, located on chromosome 11.
synonyms: Renal Cell Carcinoma with t(6;11);(p21;q12); MALAT1-TFEB
Renal Cell Carcinoma with t(6;11);(p21;q12); MALAT1::TFEB

concepts.label: TFE3-rearranged renal cell carcinoma
concepts.description: A renal cell carcinoma with MiT translocations that is characterized by the presence of different translocations involving the chromosome Xp11.2 and that result in the creation of gene fusions involving the TFE3 gene.
synonyms: Renal Cell Carcinoma Associated with Xp11.2 Translocations/TFE3 Gene Fusions

concepts.label: childhood renal cell carcinoma with MiT translocations
concepts.description: A renal cell carcinoma with MiT translocations that is characterized by a TFE3 or TFEB-rearranged renal cell carcinoma that occurs during childhood.

concepts.label: poorly differentiated chordoma
concepts.description: A chordoma that is characterized by loss of SMARCB1 expression and that is composed of sheets or nests of malignant epithelioid cells with abundant eosinophilic cytoplasm.

concepts.label: anaplastic sarcoma of the kidney
concepts.description: A kidney sarcoma that is characterized by a proliferation of anaplastic spindle cells with bizarre, pleomorphic nuclei and atypical mitotic figures.

concepts.label: angioimmunoblastic T-cell lymphoma
concepts.description: A peripheral T-cell lymphoma characterized by autoimmune features and poor prognosis.

concepts.label: nodular malignant melanoma
concepts.description: A melanoma that is characterized as highly aggressive and manifests as a uniform blue-black, blue-red, or amelanotic nodule.

concepts.label: spindle cell lipoma
concepts.description: A lipoma that is an asymptomatic, slow-growing subcutaneous tumor that has a predilection for the posterior back, neck, and shoulders of older men.

concepts.label: pleomorphic lipoma
concepts.description: A lipoma that is characterized by floret giant cells with overlapping nuclei.

concepts.label: chondroid lipoma
concepts.description: A lipoma that is a deep-seated, firm, yellow tumors that characteristically occur on the legs of women.

concepts.label: chronic leukemia
concepts.description: A leukemia that develops slowly.

concepts.label: lymphoid leukemia
concepts.description: A leukemia that has_material_basis_in a B-cell or T-cell lineage involving primarily the bone marrow and the peripheral blood.

concepts.label: prolymphocytic leukemia
concepts.description: A chronic lymphocytic leukemia that is characterized by the presence of medium-sized lymphocytes with visible nucleoli (prolymphocytes) in the peripheral blood, bone marrow, and spleen.

concepts.label: chronic lymphocytic leukemia
concepts.description: A lymphocytic leukemia characterized by over production of B-cells and their accumulation in bone marrow and blood.

concepts.label: stomach cancer
concepts.description: A gastrointestinal system cancer that is located_in the stomach.

concepts.label: mediastinum neuroblastoma

concepts.description: Class

concepts.description: An ocular cancer that has_material_basis_in melanocytes and is located_in the eye.

concepts.label: thyroid cancer
concepts.description: An endocrine gland cancer located in the thyroid gland located in the neck below the thyroid cartilage.

concepts.label: peritoneal mesothelioma
concepts.description: A peritoneum cancer that develops from cells of the mesothelium and is located_in the peritoneum.

concepts.label: malignant mesothelioma
concepts.description: A cell type cancer that has_material_basis_in mesothelial tissue that develops from the thin layer of tissue that covers many of the internal organs. Exposure to airborne asbestos particles increases one's risk of developing malignant mesothelioma.

synonyms: malignant neoplasm of islets of Langerhans
